findings.text: Every test in test_install_antigravity_bridge.py passes --target; nothing proves the scripts' default target resolves to ~/.gemini/config/skills ($HOME in .sh, USERPROFILE/HOME in .ps1), which is the path the ACs name.

findings.ac: AC3 Antigravity IDE discovers copied skills
findings.text: No test or doc evidence of discovery via an Antigravity skill listing; the diff only copies files, and test_copies_every_skill_with_references checks SKILL.md presence, not host discovery (manual verification not recorded).

test_copies_every_skill_with_references compares dest to whatever dist/skills holds (and skips if unbuilt); it never asserts the count is 26, so the 'all 26' wording is only proven if the bundle itself has 26.

findings.ac: Notes/design Track D optional plugin manifest
findings.text: Mental Model and design Track D mention an optional plugin manifest into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/stratosphere-os; neither script nor test handles it (optional, so non-blocking).
